parameters.name: ComputeCategory
parameters.description:
The computing category. Valid values:

- economy: economy.
- general: general-purpose.

parameters.name: ContainerGroupIds
parameters.description: The sequence of instance IDs. You can specify up to 20 IDs. The character string must be in JSON format.

parameters.name: ContainerGroupName
parameters.description: The instance name, which is the container group name.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description:
The maximum number of resources to return. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 20. The maximum value is 20.

> The number of returned results may be less than the specified number but never exceeds it.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next query. An empty value of NextToken indicates that no more results exist.

> You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, obtain the token from the response of the previous query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The instance status. Valid values:

- Pending: starting.
- Running: running.
- Succeeded: run succeeded.
- Failed: run failed.
- Scheduling: being created.
- ScheduleFailed: creation failed.
- Restarting: restarting.
- Updating: being updated.
- Terminating: being terminated.
- Expired: expired.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the instance.

parameters.name: WithEvent
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return event information.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone of the instance. If this parameter is left empty, the system automatically selects a zone.

Default value: empty.
